title: AI Fashion Reels for Clothing Try-On | AIVideosUGC
description: Make AI fashion reels from one clothing photo for TikTok, Instagram and product pages. Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds for each social campaign you run.
h1: AI Fashion Reels That Show the Full Outfit
lead: Make AI fashion reels from one garment photo, with an AI actor, a voiceover, and captions, so the full outfit reads in motion.
steps_h2: Make a Clothing Video Ad in 3 Steps
steps_lead: One garment photo, a spoken line, then a file you can post to TikTok or Meta.

steps.d: Show the full garment flat, on a hanger, or on a mannequin. Or paste the product page link.
Name one action and a short spoken line, then pick a size and a length from 6 to 30 seconds.
Check the color against the garment, then publish the file to TikTok or Meta. Add the size in the editor if you need it.

faq.q: What is an AI fashion reel template?
faq.a: A ready try-on scene that puts one outfit in motion. You add a garment photo, a hook, a script, and a voiceover, and an AI actor wears the look.

faq.q: How do I make the outfit reel?
faq.a: Upload the garment or paste a product page link, name one action such as a turn or a short walk, pick an AI actor, a size, and a length, then download.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of a fitting day?
faq.a: The try-on is built from the garment photo or the product link you already have. You can skip another shoot until you decide you need one.
Clothing shops, including menswear and womenswear, that need a reel, a listing, or a paid ad from one garment photo.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Yes. Use a sharp photo of the full garment and name one action. Set captions and the spoken line before you post, and check the color against the garment.
A sharp, evenly lit photo of the full garment. A flat lay, a hanger, or a mannequin can work. A product page link can stand in when you do not have the file handy.

faq.q: What should I check before posting?
faq.a: Compare the color, the fit, and the silhouette with the source photo. Add the real size and price in the editor. The person on screen is an AI actor, not a customer fit check.

faq.q: Which size and length can I pick?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for TikTok and Reels. You can also pick 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, and you can publish the file to TikTok or Meta.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. A failed job returns those credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month. There is no free plan. The download has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I run the file in ads, in another language, or from an API?
faq.a: Yes. Publish it to TikTok or Meta, speak the line in another language, and make a batch of actions from the same photo. A catalog API can start the next color. Add any platform disclosure yourself.
